rule: `self.m()` / `this.m()` / a bare call to a member of the enclosing type → `Type#m`. If `m` is defined only on a superclass that is in the scan, the callee is `Superclass#m`. | Call on a **computed receiver** (call result, index, literal, `super` when the superclass is not in the scan): `.member` — a leading dot means "receiver unknown". | Superclass constructor calls (`super(...)`, `: base(...)`, ...) → `Parent#<init>`, constructor.
notes: Log is defined only on Shape (in the scan): bare and this. calls from Circle → App.Shape#Log. base.Describe() with the superclass in the scan names Shape's definition (the computed-receiver form applies only when the superclass is not in the scan). AppError's superclass System.Exception is outside the scan: base.ToString() → `.ToString`, low; : base(msg) → System.Exception#<init>, constructor, medium (named statically, not defined in the scan). Circle's base constructor call is written explicitly (: base()) because implicit chaining is not a written call.
